Payments · Operations

Chargeback Representment

We built a workflow to pull scattered evidence into a consistent case for the team handling payment disputes.

evoke · 2025

The problem

Evidence for a dispute often existed across several steps. The operations team still had to find it, assemble a case and prepare it for a payment provider under time pressure.

The decision

We gave each part of the workflow a clear job. Automation gathered the information, an API structured the case and a model drafted evidence in the format the back office needed.

What we built

The workflow gave operations a more repeatable way to prepare cases and reduced the need to chase inputs by hand. The team could review the draft and trace what went into it.
